text:
Ravi: FYI we have a scheduled vendor-maintenance affecting GPU node firmware in eu-west2 on 2026-04-05 01:00-02:00 UTC. Theyre doing a staged NIC + BMC firmware push which will cause node reboots (~2-3m each).
Maya: What's the plan for maintaining capacity and preventing hot-cache misses?
Jun: Proposed: cohorted rolling reboots by rack, with KV warmbackfill and temporary routing tilt to eu-west1 for heavy sessions.
Priya: Can we avoid interrupting long-running inference tasks? We'll need to cordon nodes and wait for in-flight to drain or migrate.
Ravi: Yes. Steps: cordon cohort, drain non-critical tasks, allow in-flight generation to finish with 30s grace, reboot nodes, bring back, ramp tasks.
Nora: Suggested schedule (all UTC):
- 00:40: post status + internal notify
- 00:50: pre-seed KV caches in eu-west1 for high-frequency prefixes
- 00:55: cordon rack-cohort-A (10% capacity)
- 01:00: start reboot on cohort-A nodes (staggered 30s apart)
- 01:10: uncordon and validate, then move to cohort-B
- 01:40: final verification and rollback routing by 02:00
Ravi: Commands (dry-run):
```bash
redwoodctl pool cordon --pool eu-west2 --cohort rack-cohort-A --dry-run
redwoodctl pool drain --pool eu-west2 --cohort rack-cohort-A --evacuate-tasks --grace-period 30s --labels "noncritical"
redwoodctl node reboot --selector cohort=rack-cohort-A --stagger 30s --timeout 300s --dry-run
redwoodctl cache preseed --pool eu-west1 --prefix /kv/sessions --workers 6
```
Maya: Add fallback: if p99 latency in eu-west2 > baseline + 200ms for 5m, expand routing tilt to eu-west1 at 50%. Ops bot should create a ticket and auto-scale hosted capacity if needed.
Jun: Cost impact note: temporarily spilling load to hosted regions could cost an incremental ~$400/hr; if we scale up dedicated on top, could be higher. Flag finance if we hit 2hr cumulative.
Priya: App note: pause background snapshot-upload and telemetry-forward jobs with label "bulk-upload" from 00:55-02:10. Jun please patch scheduler.
Nora: I'll post tenant-facing status: "Planned short maintenance on our EU GPU nodes for firmware updates. We are performing rolling reboots with minimal expected impact; streaming calls may see short reconnects. Well monitor and update"
infra-oncall: Alerts: node_reboot_failures >1 -> page oncall; error_rate(eu-west2) >4% for 3m -> expand drain. I'll monitor and post at start/15/finish.
ops-bot: Ticket MN-4907 created. Runbook attached.
Ravi: Quick checklist: pre-seed (Jun), cordon/drain (Jun/Maya), oncall (infra-oncall), tenant comms (Nora), pause jobs (Priya), cost watch (Jun). Any blockers?
Maya: None. Run dry-run at 00:30, live at 00:50. Keeping thread for live updates. :thumbsup:
